title: Element-Wise Femoral Stress Prediction: A Hybrid Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Finite Element Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.24274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hip fractures represent a significant clinical challenge because they cause excess disability and mortality, and have a growing incidence in aging populations, as bone fragility increases. Although finite element analysis (FEA) provides biomechanical assessment of femoral strength, its clinical applicability is mainly limited by high computational cost. Conventional machine learning (ML) approaches have been explored as surrogate models for FEA; predictions are fast but fail to capture the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes. To address these limitations, this study proposes a hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework for femoral stress prediction using graph-structured finite element modeling (FEM) data. translated_title: 单元级股骨应力预测：一种用于有限元分析的混合图神经网络代理模型
translated_abstract: 髋部骨折是一个重大的临床挑战，因为它会导致较高的致残率和死亡率，且随着人口老龄化及骨骼脆性的增加，其发病率不断上升。尽管有限元分析（FEA）能够对股骨强度进行生物力学评估，但其临床适用性主要受限于高昂的计算成本。传统机器学习（ML）方法已被探索作为FEA的代理模型，虽然预测速度快，但无法捕捉有限元网格的空间和拓扑结构。为解决这些局限性，本研究提出了一种基于混合图神经网络（GNN）的框架，利用图结构化的有限元建模（FEM）数据进行股骨应力预测。所提出的GCN-SAGE-Residual架构结合了图卷积、邻域聚合和残差学习，以建模网格单元间的空间依赖关系和应力传播。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合图卷积、邻域聚合与残差学习的混合图神经网络（GCN-SAGE-Residual）代理模型，可在保留有限元网格空间拓扑结构的前提下实现快速的单元级股骨应力预测，克服了传统有限元分析计算成本高、常规机器学习模型忽略网格结构的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid GCN-SAGE-Residual graph neural network surrogate combining graph convolution, neighborhood aggregation, and residual learning to enable fast element-wise femoral stress prediction while preserving the spatial and topological structure of finite element meshes.
